g.text: Domain Model Excerpt - BCK09 Stock Information Management
Product has its own active state.
- A Product is under stock tracking when it
has one StockInformation record with no endedAt.
- A Product has at most one current record and
- Disabling tracking records endedAt and preserves
the final quantity, including a non-zero balance.
- Enabling tracking creates a new period with
startedAt and Manager-supplied units, or zero.
- A decrease that would make the quantity
- A zero quantity does not deactivate Product.
- Snapshots do not record stock movements.
A period is current when endedAt is empty; setting endedAt closes that period. All completed periods and their final quantities are retained. Product activation remains independent.
